selection_rule: Validation only. C1 is the all-family configuration with the highest validation average precision in validation_runs.jsonl. C2 is C1 without the static kyc registry family. C3 is the regularized base-feature model. Each candidate is evaluated on the frozen test cohort exactly once and every evaluation is appended to test_ledger.jsonl. The test evaluator accepts a candidate only when its name appears here and its grid configuration still hashes to the recorded config_hash; a changed configuration is a new experiment, not an overwrite.
